cardOverview.overviewText: A Pinnacle card offering high reward rates, global travel privileges, milestone benefits, and concierge support for premium customers.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: B1G1 offer on movies thrice per month, with a maximum benefit of ₹200 each time, and a 20% discount on non-movie bookings through BookMyShow, capped at ₹200 off per transaction.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: Pinnacle Concierge provides a range of pre-trip services, including destination information, weather updates, and recommendations for transport and landmarks.|The concierge handles hotel reservations at top hotels worldwide, ensuring a comfortable stay.|Flight bookings are made to reach your desired destination, while tickets for global sports events, like football matches or Wimbledon, can be arranged.|Exclusive bookings for special events, workshops, or seminars by renowned personalities are also available.|Additionally, the concierge assists with sending flowers or gifts, ensuring timely delivery of special items like Swiss watches or French wine to anywhere in the world.
